question: Should OpenClaw add an agent-scoped web/tool credential override surface, and should that surface live under `agents.list[].tools.web`, plugin-owned per-agent config, or a unified credential model?
rationale: Source inspection proves the gap, but choosing the permanent surface affects credential isolation, SecretRef precedence, plugin ownership boundaries, config compatibility, and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Design unified credential contract
options.body: Keep this issue open and define one agent-scoped credential model that covers web tools, plugin-owned webSearch config, SecretRefs, validation, reload or restart semantics, docs, and tests before implementation.

options.title: Fold into plugin config design
options.body: Treat this as a subset of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/55401 and require that broader per-agent plugin config contract to explicitly cover web-search credentials.

options.title: Decline per-agent tool credentials
options.body: Document separate gateways, existing per-agent model defaults, and external credential isolation as the supported boundary for distinct web-search billing or accounts.

recommendation.title: Design unified credential contract
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and define one agent-scoped credential model that covers web tools, plugin-owned webSearch config, SecretRefs, validation, reload or restart semantics, docs, and tests before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision spans config compatibility, SecretRef/security behavior, and plugin-boundary ownership where repository ownership and history point most strongly to this handle.
